descriptionChirho: Abstract sin or transgression against God or moral law — the act or condition of sinning, used in contexts such as confession of sin and the consequences of wrongdoing. English 'sin/a sin,' Spanish 'pecado,' Hindi पाप, Arabic خطيئة, Korean 죄, Swahili dhambi. Occurs 7 times as a noun in various syntactic frames (with article, with preposition ל).

A sacrifice offered to atone for sin, a technical cultic term designating the purification or sin offering in the Levitical system. English 'and sin-offering,' Spanish 'y ofrenda por pecado,' Hindi और पापबलि (compound: sin-sacrifice), Arabic وخطيئة, Korean 속죄제 (atonement-offering), Swahili 'na sadaka-ya-dhambi' (and sacrifice-of-sin). The shift from abstract sin to concrete sacrificial offering represents a distinct lexicographic sense via metonymy.
